fieldData.description: To celebrate the 1 year anniversary of Radix mainnet launch, come share drink & food with your Belgium community members and chat about crypto, DeFi, and of course RadixDLT! This event will be very casual and welcoming. Anyone who wants to make friends and learn about DeFi is welcome. Did we mention there's free food and drinks for everyone? Feel free to reach out to @Squidward_XRD on Telegram for any questions!
fieldData.name: Radix Community Meet up - Belgium
